title: A comparison between statistics and 't Hooft anomaly
summary: Anomalies of generalized symmetries are closely related to the statistics of topological excitations. Truncating a symmetry transformation to a finite region produces an operator that creates symmetry defects on its boundary; we call this a symmetry patch operator. Such operators resemble hopping operators that create topological excitations at the boundary of their support, but this geometric similarity does not justify identifying the two.
